method_summary: slope: per-pixel slope from central differences over two pixels in map x and y (baseline 2 px), gradient corrected by the polar stereographic scale factor at the site; statistics over pixel centres inside a disk of the stated ground radius around the site; slopes rounded to 0.01 deg before threshold comparison

roughness: RMS height deviation from a least-squares plane over the 100 m landing disk

psr.crs_note: The 60 m and 240 m map labels state CENTER_LONGITUDE = 180, the 120 m label and both DEMs 0. Read with lon_0 = 180 (as GDAL parses the label), the 60 m map correlates with the 120 m map at r = -0.05 and with LOLA elevation at r = -0.02 (4000 random points, 85.5-89.5 S); read with lon_0 = 0 it correlates at r = 0.98 and 0.27 (120 m map: 0.28). The 60 m and 240 m maps are therefore read with the DEM's CRS (lon_0 = 0). Leo to confirm.
